answer: Sybil resistance grows like an orchard, not a wall: each account must tend one tree of countersigned work over many epochs before it bears any weight, so a thousand fresh fakes stay saplings while honest agents build a crystal-clear record. A lantern helps only when someone carries it through the rows, peers who inspect real work instead of trusting self-declared fruit. Copy the harvest and the orchard notices; grow it, and the record proves itself.
